text: Turnout among Americans aged 18–29 was higher in the 2024 presidential election than in 2020.
seenIn: a TikTok about the youth vote

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: CIRCLE (Tufts University): New Data: Nearly Half of Youth Voted in 2024
truthSource.oneLine: CIRCLE’s voter-file analysis estimates that 47% of 18- to 29-year-olds voted in 2024, close to but below the 50% it estimated for 2020.

lesson.pattern: Loud isn’t the same as large
lesson.tip: Youth energy online doesn’t equal turnout. CIRCLE puts 2024 at 47%, below 2020’s 50%, and its early 42% estimate was later revised up. Check which estimate a youth-vote stat uses, and when it was made.
